mapper.insert: insert into logistics (order_id, carrier_code, carrier_name, tracking_no, ship_status, shipped_at, delivered_at, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{carrierCode}, #{carrierName}, #{trackingNo}, #{shipStatus}, #{shippedAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
